info.name: Report API
info.description: Endpoints for reporting reel content, allowing users to flag inappropriate reels and admins to review, block, or unblock them.

item.name: Report
item.description: Report a reel for inappropriate content. Sends an email notification to all admins via BullMQ.

request.description: Submit a report for a reel. Requires authentication. The `reason` is required; `message` and `tags` are optional. Prevents duplicate reports from the same user on the same reel.

response.name: 201 Created
response.body:
{
    "success": true,
    "report": {
        "id": "uuid",
        "reelId": "uuid",
        "reportedById": "uuid",
        "reason": "Sexual content",
        "message": "This reel contains inappropriate material.",
        "tags": ["sexual", "explicit"],
        "status": "PENDING",
        "isBlocked": false,
        "blockReason": null,
        "createdAt": "2026-05-13T10:00:00.000Z",
        "updatedAt": "2026-05-13T10:00:00.000Z"
    },
    "msg": "Report submitted successfully"
}

query.description: Filter by status: PENDING, RESOLVED, REJECTED
Cursor for pagination (returned as nextCursor in response)

request.description: List all reports with optional status filter. Admin only. Supports cursor-based pagination. Includes reel details, reporter info, and resolver info.

response.name: 200 OK

variable.description: ID of the report to resolve

request.description: Resolve or reject a report. Admin only. Set `status` to `RESOLVED` (accepted) or `REJECTED` (dismissed). Set `blockReel: true` to also block the reel. When blocking, `blockReason` is shown to the reel owner.

response.name: 200 OK

variable.description: ID of the report to reject

request.description: Dismiss/reject a report without blocking the reel. Admin only.

variable.description: ID of the reel to block

request.description: Directly block a reel without going through a report. Admin only. Blocked reels are hidden from all feeds except the reel owner's own feed.

variable.description: ID of the reel to unblock

request.description: Unblock a previously blocked reel. Admin only. The reel becomes visible in all feeds again.
List all currently blocked reels. Admin only. Supports cursor-based pagination. Shows the block reason and reel owner info.

response.name: 200 OK
